BiblicalUsage: Sholal means stripped, bare, carried away captive, and Job uses it for the counsellors and princes God leads away spoiled, while Micah takes it on himself, wailing that he will go stripped and naked like the dragons and the owls. The word is what is left when dignity is taken.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God strips the proud so they can see themselves plainly, and He humbles in order to heal.
